posts.text: Unveiled the 18-ft Bharat Mata sculpture at New Vadaj Circle in Ahmedabad. Every border district will have a 360-degree security framework. Never let India's head bow — demolish all illegal structures within 15 km of the International Border.

posts.text: Met NEET aspirants today. Their frustration is real — the Modi govt has failed our youth on exam integrity. India's young people will transform this system. We will raise this in Parliament.
posts.caption: Met NEET aspirants today. Their frustration is real — the Modi govt has failed our youth on exam integrity. India's young people will transform this system. We will raise this in Parliament.

posts.text: Medical education in UP is being transformed with modern technology and infrastructure. PG seats have risen from 1,344 to 5,067 and MBBS seats from 5,390 to 12,800 in a decade. Quality healthcare for all remains our mission.
posts.caption: Medical education in UP is being transformed with modern technology and infrastructure. PG seats have risen from 1,344 to 5,067 and MBBS seats from 5,390 to 12,800 in a decade. Quality healthcare for all remains our mission.

posts.text: The fight against corruption must continue. People of Delhi deserve honest governance, world-class education, and affordable healthcare. That is what AAP stands for and will always stand for.
posts.caption: The fight against corruption must continue. People of Delhi deserve honest governance, world-class education, and affordable healthcare. That is what AAP stands for and will always stand for.

posts.text: Productive meetings at the Gymnich gathering in Cyprus with Estonian FM Margus Tsahkna and EU Commissioner Dubravka Šuica. India-EU ties are entering a decisive phase — the FTA negotiations reflect our deepening strategic partnership.
posts.caption: Productive meetings at the Gymnich gathering in Cyprus with Estonian FM Margus Tsahkna and EU Commissioner Dubravka Šuica. India-EU ties are entering a decisive phase — the FTA negotiations reflect our deepening strategic partnership.

posts.text: 10,000 new medical seats in 2026, 75,000 over five years. Expanding IIT infrastructure and establishing AI education centres. The Budget is delivering on our commitment to India's youth and human capital.
posts.caption: 10,000 new medical seats in 2026, 75,000 over five years. Expanding IIT infrastructure and establishing AI education centres. The Budget is delivering on our commitment to India's youth and human capital.

posts.text: All criminal charges dropped by the US DOJ. The Adani Group is investing Rs 6 lakh crore across aviation, clean energy, urban development, and manufacturing. India's growth story is unstoppable.
posts.caption: All criminal charges dropped by the US DOJ. The Adani Group is investing Rs 6 lakh crore across aviation, clean energy, urban development, and manufacturing. India's growth story is unstoppable.

posts.text: True wealth lies in meaningful, impactful giving — not material accumulation. I hope the next generation carries forward the spirit of building institutions that serve humanity. 🙏

posts.text: Conferred the President's Police Colour on Sikkim Police in Gangtok — the 15th state to receive this honour. Also flagged off Sikkim's first women-only Pink Bus service 'Aama Didi Bahini Sewa.' Empowering women and strengthening institutions.
posts.caption: Conferred the President's Police Colour on Sikkim Police in Gangtok — the 15th state to receive this honour. Also flagged off Sikkim's first women-only Pink Bus service 'Aama Didi Bahini Sewa.' Empowering women and strengthening institutions.

posts.text: Iran is negotiating on fumes. Everything's gone — we wiped out their navy and air force. If they don't give in, Pete Hegseth is going to finish them off. Maybe we get a deal, maybe we don't. But the Strait of Hormuz WILL reopen.
posts.caption: Iran is negotiating on fumes. Everything's gone — we wiped out their navy and air force. If they don't give in, Pete Hegseth is going to finish them off. Maybe we get a deal, maybe we don't. But the Strait of Hormuz WILL reopen.

posts.text: If we can fix financial literacy, it's one of the most powerful things we can do to improve social mobility. It underpins the jobs people apply for, the opportunities they pursue, and the financial resilience that lets them get on in life.
posts.caption: If we can fix financial literacy, it's one of the most powerful things we can do to improve social mobility. It underpins the jobs people apply for, the opportunities they pursue, and the financial resilience that lets them get on in life.

posts.text: Congrats Shrey! 🇺🇸 Also: found common ground to combat Medicaid fraud and return recovered funds to Ohio residents. We deserve the government we elect — and we can make it better.
posts.caption: Congrats Shrey! 🇺🇸 Also: found common ground to combat Medicaid fraud and return recovered funds to Ohio residents. We deserve the government we elect — and we can make it better.

posts.text: Loved reading with Team USA athletes and kids at the Olympic Training Center in Colorado Springs today! Summer reading matters — every book a child picks up builds their confidence and imagination. Join the Summer Reading Challenge! 📚
posts.caption: Loved reading with Team USA athletes and kids at the Olympic Training Center in Colorado Springs today! Summer reading matters — every book a child picks up builds their confidence and imagination. Join the Summer Reading Challenge! 📚

posts.text: World Cup security is our top priority. 3 million visitors coming to the US — we're tracking cyber threats, drone risks, and lone-wolf attacks. The FBI is ready. Community engagement and advanced drone defense are key.
posts.caption: World Cup security is our top priority. 3 million visitors coming to the US — we're tracking cyber threats, drone risks, and lone-wolf attacks. The FBI is ready. Community engagement and advanced drone defense are key.

posts.text: India has a massive opportunity to leverage the American AI stack. $600B in US AI investment is creating tools the world can build on. Local language AI support is the unlock for the next billion users.
posts.caption: India has a massive opportunity to leverage the American AI stack. $600B in US AI investment is creating tools the world can build on. Local language AI support is the unlock for the next billion users.

posts.text: The World Bank must evolve to meet the scale of today's challenges — from climate to digital infrastructure. Development finance needs to be faster, bolder, and more responsive to emerging economies.
posts.caption: The World Bank must evolve to meet the scale of today's challenges — from climate to digital infrastructure. Development finance needs to be faster, bolder, and more responsive to emerging economies.

posts.text: Deeper economic cooperation with the EU is essential. We're negotiating alignment on standards to ease trade costs and boost productivity. In these turbulent times, Britain needs economic stability and stronger partnerships.
posts.caption: Deeper economic cooperation with the EU is essential. We're negotiating alignment on standards to ease trade costs and boost productivity. In these turbulent times, Britain needs economic stability and stronger partnerships.

posts.text: Australia welcomes Microsoft's $25 billion investment to support our National AI Plan. This is about jobs, digital infrastructure, cybersecurity, and building an AI-ready workforce for the future.
posts.caption: Australia welcomes Microsoft's $25 billion investment to support our National AI Plan. This is about jobs, digital infrastructure, cybersecurity, and building an AI-ready workforce for the future.

posts.text: Norway will open talks with France on joining our nuclear umbrella. Europe must be prepared to defend itself — we cannot rely solely on the United States for our collective security.
posts.caption: Norway will open talks with France on joining our nuclear umbrella. Europe must be prepared to defend itself — we cannot rely solely on the United States for our collective security.

posts.text: Dubai continues to lead in innovation, infrastructure, and global business. Our vision is clear — a city that attracts the world's best talent and creates opportunities for the next generation.
posts.caption: Dubai continues to lead in innovation, infrastructure, and global business. Our vision is clear — a city that attracts the world's best talent and creates opportunities for the next generation.

posts.text: SpaceX has not committed to leasing Colossus for years, although it's possible that may be what happens. The short term was our request, not Anthropic's. We won't leave them hanging but if compute gets super tight I said we might need it back.
posts.caption: SpaceX has not committed to leasing Colossus for years, although it's possible that may be what happens. The short term was our request, not Anthropic's. We won't leave them hanging but if compute gets super tight I said we might need it back.

posts.text: Competing with AWS and Microsoft Azure is definitely on the table. We're investing $115-135B in Superintelligence Labs this year. 2026 is the year personal superintelligence becomes real.
posts.caption: Competing with AWS and Microsoft Azure is definitely on the table. We're investing $115-135B in Superintelligence Labs this year. 2026 is the year personal superintelligence becomes real.

posts.text: Google I/O 2026: the shift from prompts to action has arrived. Gemini 3.5 Flash, a reimagined Android, and a proactive Chrome browser — AI that doesn't just suggest, it delivers. India's $15B AI hub in Vizag is a game-changer.
posts.caption: Google I/O 2026: the shift from prompts to action has arrived. Gemini 3.5 Flash, a reimagined Android, and a proactive Chrome browser — AI that doesn't just suggest, it delivers. India's $15B AI hub in Vizag is a game-changer.

posts.text: 2026 is the year AI shifts from hype to impact. We're moving from models to systems — AI as scaffolding for human potential, not replacement. Copilot is becoming an embedded operating layer. $190B in capital expenditures this year.
posts.caption: 2026 is the year AI shifts from hype to impact. We're moving from models to systems — AI as scaffolding for human potential, not replacement. Copilot is becoming an embedded operating layer. $190B in capital expenditures this year.

posts.text: AI has not taken as many white-collar jobs as I feared. The jobs apocalypse isn't happening — instead, AI is creating new opportunities. OpenAI IPO coming soon. Anthropic just raised at $965B — this space is moving fast.
posts.caption: AI has not taken as many white-collar jobs as I feared. The jobs apocalypse isn't happening — instead, AI is creating new opportunities. OpenAI IPO coming soon. Anthropic just raised at $965B — this space is moving fast.

posts.text: Apple Q2 2026: $111.2 billion in revenue, 17% year-over-year growth. Incredible team. As I prepare to transition to Executive Chairman, I'm proud of what we've built. John Ternus will lead Apple into its next great chapter.
posts.caption: Apple Q2 2026: $111.2 billion in revenue, 17% year-over-year growth. Incredible team. As I prepare to transition to Executive Chairman, I'm proud of what we've built. John Ternus will lead Apple into its next great chapter.

posts.text: Taiwan is the epicenter of the AI revolution. We're spending $100 billion a year here, going to $150 billion. Our new Taiwan headquarters breaks ground this year. Vera Rubin launches H2 2026 — AI inference costs drop 90%.
posts.caption: Taiwan is the epicenter of the AI revolution. We're spending $100 billion a year here, going to $150 billion. Our new Taiwan headquarters breaks ground this year. Vera Rubin launches H2 2026 — AI inference costs drop 90%.

posts.text: India's digital public infrastructure is a model for the world. From Aadhaar to UPI to now AI — the next wave will be AI-powered public services that reach every citizen. We must build this right.
posts.caption: India's digital public infrastructure is a model for the world. From Aadhaar to UPI to now AI — the next wave will be AI-powered public services that reach every citizen. We must build this right.

posts.text: By accelerating our giving, my hope is we can put the world on a path to ending preventable deaths of moms and babies. $200 billion by 2045. The Gates Foundation will wind down — but the impact must outlast us.
posts.caption: By accelerating our giving, my hope is we can put the world on a path to ending preventable deaths of moms and babies. $200 billion by 2045. The Gates Foundation will wind down — but the impact must outlast us.

posts.text: Enterprise AI is no longer experimental — it's operational. IBM is embedding AI across hybrid cloud and consulting to help businesses make smarter decisions at scale. The transformation is happening now.
posts.caption: Enterprise AI is no longer experimental — it's operational. IBM is embedding AI across hybrid cloud and consulting to help businesses make smarter decisions at scale. The transformation is happening now.

posts.text: Building what's next. The AI infrastructure wave needs founders who understand both scale and responsibility. Excited to be investing in the next generation of builders.
posts.caption: Building what's next. The AI infrastructure wave needs founders who understand both scale and responsibility. Excited to be investing in the next generation of builders.

posts.caption: Not my best IPL — 4 wickets in 13 matches. Had a niggle coming back from the World Cup. But I'm focused on recovery and getting ready for the Afghanistan Test and England series. The work continues.

posts.text: Difficult season. 4 wins in 14 matches is not good enough. I take full responsibility as captain. We'll learn from this and build for the future. Mumbai Indians will bounce back.
